payload.body: Fixed in PR #7, coherently with FR-235's ownership predicate. (a) Fail-open ownership: a row with no/empty owner value is visible, so a DB migrated from 0.1.1 (grants present, no ownership) never hides its rows. (b) Writer-echo guarantee: writes carry the writing principal's userId (FrickStoreWriteEvent.writerUserId, threaded through WS ObjectUpsert + HTTP write paths and the cluster bus), and the fan-out always passes the ownership baseline for that principal's own subscriptions, so a writer always receives its own delta regardless of owner-field state. Regression test (stale grant present + new write -> writer receives echo + snapshot includes row) in apps/server/tests/owner-scoped-reads.test.ts. NOTE: full twice-through RangerCRM E2E not run to completion this session; server-side tests cover the stale-grant path directly.
